tickets.title: Define the axiom JSON schema and validator
tickets.description: Slot, tags, conflicts, and the directive blocks (terrain, settlement, biomes, poi, enemies, traversal, economy, palette, audio). Enforce the rule that every axiom touches at least four blocks.

tickets.title: Implement slot rolling for A-E from the world seed
tickets.description: Five independent slots, Anomaly rolled on ~33% of seeds. Deterministic from worldSeed. Doc 01, slot architecture.

tickets.title: Implement directive merging with slot priority
tickets.description: Merge directive blocks with conflicts resolved by slot priority A > B > C > D > E into a single WorldConfig.

tickets.title: Implement the conflicts blocklist
tickets.description: Hard blocklist preventing incoherent pairs (e.g. Deukalion's Flood + Demeter's Grief). Blocking is cheaper than reconciling.

tickets.title: Author Cataclysm axioms: Silence of the Oracles, Deukalion's Flood, Artemis Withdrew
tickets.description: Ship-three for slot A. Each needs full directive blocks plus supporting content references. The Silence is attested - Plutarch wrote on the oracles falling silent.

tickets.title: Author Law axioms: Hecatomb, Orichalcum, The Last Favour
tickets.description: Ship-three for slot B. Highest mechanical reach of any slot - these drive combat, economy, progression and HUD.

tickets.title: Author Powers axioms: The League, The Satrapy, The Hegemony
tickets.description: Ship-three for slot C. Drives faction ecology, settlement density and road quality.

tickets.title: Author Pressure axioms: The Miasma, The Unburied, The Foretold
tickets.description: Ship-three for slot D. The prophecy. Hidden at creation, discovered in play. Miasma is purified rather than fought.

tickets.title: Author Anomaly axioms: three from the list
tickets.description: Ship-three for slot E. Tiresias, the Labyrinth, the reachable underworld. Rolled ~33% of seeds.

tickets.title: Handle the Poleis 'no single Incumbent' special case
tickets.description: Three or four city-states each running the Incumbent script at reduced scale. Doc 03.

tickets.title: Handle the Dark Age post-state faction ecology
tickets.description: No Incumbent at all; Parasites and Refuseniks expand into the vacuum. The Greek Dark Age is attested, not invented. Doc 03.

tickets.title: World title and summary composition
tickets.description: Generate the new-game screen block (e.g. 'The Salt Years - the flood never fully drew back...'). This is save identity, marketing, and the thing players screenshot.

tickets.title: New-game screen: show slots A-C, hide D and E
tickets.description: Players choose their fantasy from Cataclysm, Law and Powers; the prophecy and the anomaly are discovered in play.

tickets.title: Shared data/ loading in both generator and game
tickets.description: Axiom JSON read by libworldforge and cooked to the engine's binary data format at build time. Single source of truth. Doc 17.
